title: Admin completed, content filled in
desc: Site copy, the about page and the changelog all moved into the admin; blogroll avatars are uploadable and project cards sync from GitHub in one click. Seven new build notes written.

title: Interaction and real data
desc: The home-page music card plays and follows lyrics; the whole site moved to client-side routing for smooth page changes; every number on the panels is now real data.

title: A counting service of my own
desc: Likes and read counts moved to a small Go service I wrote. It stores anonymous totals only — no IPs, no user agents.

title: From design to code
desc: The interface design was finalised, the Astro project set up, and the home page and every section rebuilt one-to-one, block by block.
